Sundar Pichai@sundarpichai · Nov 11

Sundar Pichai announced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model in Google AI Studio (6,912 likes).

Today we’re launching the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model in @GoogleAIStudio.

Instead of generating text token by token, it’s built for closed-set choices scoring up to 1,000 questions across text, images, audio, video + PDFs in a single pass. A few details:

- 3 decision types: yes/no, multiple choice (up to 255 options) + rubric scoring
- $0.10 / 1M input tokens with $0 billed for output tokens (~5x cheaper than Flash-Lite)
- leads on several benchmark evals with lowest calibration error

Google teams are already building with it, below is a look at Stitch Rapid designing a full product flow in seconds (1x speed)

Sundar Pichai@sundarpichai · Nov 11

Sundar Pichai said AlphaGenome 2 helps uncover the cellular drivers of disease (2,385 likes).

AlphaGenome 2 is helping uncover the cellular drivers of disease, giving scientists a powerful tool to predict how DNA variants impact specific cell types.

Every cell in our body shares the same DNA blueprint, but different cell types (like heart muscle cells vs. immune cells) read that blueprint differently. This new @GoogleDeepMind model predicts how these specialized cells interpret DNA, turning genetic code into biological insights.

Building on AlphaGenome 1 this makes it significantly easier for researchers to link genetic findings to the root causes of disease in the specific cells where they actually unfold.

NVIDIA AI introduced Déjà View, a 117M-parameter model that turns photos into 3D geometry and camera positions (719 likes).

Meet Déjà View, a model that turns photos taken from different angles into 3D geometry and camera positions.

By looping a single transformer block, this 117M-parameter model matches or outperforms models up to 10x larger across five benchmarks, using comparable or less compute. Researchers can dial the number of loops to fit their compute budget.
